I ran the linters and the project's rules on your 3 uncommitted files and checked each against your coding standards. There are 3 errors and 7 warnings.

```
Code standards: uncommitted changes, 3 files, 3.5s (ast-grep 1.7s, lizard 0.6s, jscpd 3.5s, ruff 2.2s, oxlint 2.6s)
Errors
  app/api/loyalty_routes.py
    10  cs-env-outside-config  os.environ.get("LOYALTY_RATE", ...): read it from app.config.settings instead
  app/services/loyalty_service.py
     1  ruff/F401              `json` is imported but never used   [fix]
  web/src/components/LoyaltyBadge.tsx
    10  oxlint/no-debugger     a leftover `debugger;` statement   [fix]
Warnings
  app/api/loyalty_routes.py
    11  std-routes-delegate    the handler calls get_db().fetch_one(...) directly; pass get_db() to a service function instead
    12  std-routes-delegate    business logic in the handler: a missing customer returns {"points": 0}, and lines 14–15 double the rate for gold. Move this into loyalty_service and let a LookupError become a 404
  app/services/loyalty_service.py
     9  std-service-errors     find_customer returns None for a missing customer; raise LookupError(f"customer {customer_id} not found")
    13  lizard/complexity      points_for has complexity 11 (limit 10)
  web/src/components/LoyaltyBadge.tsx
     6  std-components-use-api-modules  the component calls fetch(...) directly; add a typed function in web/src/api/customer.ts (or similar) and call that
    14  lizard/complexity      summarize has complexity 12 (limit 10)
    14  jscpd/duplicate        summarize is a 12-line copy of web/src/components/InvoiceList.tsx:24-35
```

**One fix covers several findings:** if `find_customer` raises `LookupError` (`loyalty_service.py:9`), the route can call `loyalty_service` once and stop reading the database itself. That clears both route warnings.

**Duplicate:** `summarize` is the same code as in `InvoiceList.tsx`. Put one copy in a shared module and import it from both places rather than keeping two.

The two `[fix]` items can be fixed automatically. I can apply those and work through the rest by hand if you want.
